lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Five firms are pooling their models this year. Ours is the one with a conscience, which is precisely why I am four hours up a mountain offering a monastery a stipend, instead of down there buying the valley outright, which is what any of the other four would have done by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: You people are not on my manifest, you have no business on this terrace, and I have stopped caring on both counts. Talk to Kell. She is the one stalling, and she is stalling well.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: A pleasure doing business with a house that understands risk. Most of them do not; most of them think risk is the weather.
